notes: 'every one that believeth' split three ways under rule 80's closing clause: 'every' to πάντα, 'one' to the article, 'that believeth' to the participle.
The complementizer 'that' goes to the infinitive λαβεῖν under rule 85, and μαρτυροῦσιν heads on 'witness' under rule 91's unbroken corpus line.
